verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 docs describe first-party command-line tooling: health-check commands for the system and the `nvidia-smi` tool, which reports GPU data. That is an official CLI, but the evidence only shows it for health monitoring and GPU reporting, with no documentation of its command surface or AI-native use. missing for 10: a documented full CLI reference, machine-readable/agent-friendly output modes, coverage beyond health and GPU reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: It also provides simple commands for checking the health of the DGX B200 system from the command line.
The maximum power per GPU is reported by the `nvidia-smi` tool.
